title: Chapter 69 Division Operation
content:
Chapter 69 Division Operation

In the main hall of the Lord's Mansion of Huangcheng.

At this moment, Gu Chen and other people in Huangcheng are talking with the people of the Changsheng Immortal Clan and the Immortal Emperor Clan.

There are three ruins, namely the Human Emperor Palace, the Heavenly Palace and the Holy Gate.

For these forces, the people of Huangcheng are not particularly familiar with them.

So they still have to rely on the people of these two clans to solve the puzzles.

After all, these two clans were ancient forces in the same period as the human race. Although they were not as powerful as the human race back then, they were also existences that should not be underestimated.

"Patriarch Li, are you sure you want to gather us together?"

At this time, Gu Chen spoke.

Hearing this, Li Changyue said: "This is just my opinion."

Li Changyue said that collective action is necessary to explore these ruins.

Although the efficiency may be a little poor, the safety is extremely high.

However, this suggestion was not only disagreed by Huangcheng and others, but also by the Immortal Emperor Clan and others.

The Immortal Emperor Clan has strong vitality, is not afraid of death, and is not on good terms with the Changsheng Immortal Clan.

If they had not wanted to cooperate with Huangcheng this time, they would not stand with the people of the Changsheng Immortal Clan.

On the Huangcheng side, Lu Daosheng had already told them that this time, the opportunity was secondary, and training was the main thing.

They had not warmed up for a long time since they came to the Wanling Realm. To be honest, they were a little hungry and thirsty.

So it might be better for Gu Chen, Yunqi and others to disperse a little.

At this time, Emperor Ming said directly: "I will lead several members of my clan to the Heavenly Court, you are free to do whatever you want."

As he said, Emperor Ming looked directly at the people of Huangcheng, and the meaning was self-evident.

Seeing this, Gu Chen shook his head and smiled.

In the end, the three forces were divided into three groups of people, each going to three ruins.

Gu Chen and Yunqi went to the Heavenly Court ruins with the Undead Emperor Clan and others.

A Wei and Huang Shou went to the Holy Gate ruins with the Changsheng Immortal Clan and others.

Because Ouyang Yanqing and Ao Qing were still accompanying Lu Xue at the moment, they did not come to participate.

In the end, An Xing was left alone to explore the Human Emperor Palace.

Gu Chen came over and patted An Xing, smiling: "Brother An, you have to be careful when you are alone."

"But don't worry, after we finish exploring, maybe we can go to the Human Emperor Palace to find you."

Hearing this, An Xing's mouth twitched slightly.

No one actually teamed up with him. Who can do it and who can't. A friend in need is a friend indeed.

And just at this moment, a voice suddenly sounded from the hall.

"I want to go too!"

I saw a little beauty in a blue dress running towards here.

"I, I want to go too."

Lu Xue took a breath and smiled.

Seeing Lu Xue, Huang Cheng and others hurriedly saluted.

"Hello, Miss."

On the side, the people of the Undead Emperor Clan and the Immortal Clan were puzzled.

"Who is this?"

They couldn't see through Lu Xue at all.

Hearing this, Gu Chen introduced: "This is the daughter of our city lord, Miss Lu Xue."

The daughter of the city lord.

Suddenly, everyone's eyes lit up when they looked at Lu Xue.

Emperor Ming took the lead and said, "Miss Lu, come and team up with us. With the strength of our Immortal Emperor Clan, we can definitely protect you."

Hearing this, Li Changyue on the side snorted coldly and said, "What's the use of your Immortal Emperor Clan except that you can't be killed? When you encounter danger, only you are fine. What can you use to protect Miss Lu?"

Then Li Changyue looked at Lu Xue and smiled, "Miss Lu, you should go to the Holy Gate with our Changsheng Immortal Clan. Our Changsheng Immortal Clan is powerful and definitely much stronger than the Immortal Emperor Clan."

Soon, Emperor Ming and everyone in the Immortal Emperor Clan turned pale.

"Old man, you said that my Immortal Emperor Clan is useless?!"

"What, am I wrong?"

"Fuck, I have tolerated you for a long time, do you really think that my Immortal Emperor Clan can't beat you?"

"Humph, come if you want, my Changsheng Immortal Clan is really not afraid of you!"

For a while, the two clans almost fought in the hall.

However, at this moment, a powerful aura suddenly appeared in the hall, instantly suppressing the cultivation of everyone in the hall.

"This is such a strong restriction!"

Suddenly, everyone from the two tribes looked at the hall with a solemn expression.

The Lord of the Desolate City was too terrifying to be able to easily suppress the two tribe leaders in the Heavenly Fate Realm.

At this time, Lu Xue said: "I will not go to the Holy Gate, nor to the Heavenly Court, I will go to the Human Emperor Palace."

Human Emperor Palace!

As soon as this was said, An Xing, who had been silent in the corner, suddenly looked overjoyed.

Miss is still good to me.

"Miss, I am going to the Human Emperor Palace, why don't you go with me."

At this time, An Xing stood up and said.

Seeing An Xing, Lu Xue hesitated and finally nodded.

"Okay."

On weekdays, An Xing did not flatter me a lot. Whatever I wanted, An Xing would give it to me at the first time. If I wanted to know something, as long as I let him know, An Xing would tell him immediately.

It can be said that he is always available.

Therefore, Lu Xue is still very satisfied with An Xing.

No wonder her father is so good to An Xing and often helps him practice.

Seeing Lu Xue agree, An Xing was extremely excited and immediately glanced at everyone present with a proud look.

See, the daughter of the city lord is in the same group with me, which is much better than you.

Seeing An Xing so proud, Gu Chen coughed lightly and said: "Xiaoxue, although An Xing is reliable, it is still a bit dangerous for you two to be in the ruins of the Human Emperor Palace. Why don't you..."

Before he finished speaking, a voice came from a distance.

"Did you forget me?"

I saw Ouyang Yanqing slowly walking from a distance.

Heavenly King Realm!

Seeing this, the ancestor of the immortals and the people of the Immortal Imperial Clan were shocked.

How many powerful people do they don’t know about in this deserted city?

At this time, Lu Xue's arm suddenly started to squirm, and the next moment, a little dragon poked a head out of her cuff.

"Don't forget that I still have Benlong. With me here, no one can hurt the little master."

Ao Qing.

Hearing Ao Qing's words, everyone in Huangcheng looked at Ao Qing.

Have you forgotten how Miss came to the world of spirits?

He actually had the face to say this, but looking at Ao Qing's arrogant expression, everyone still did not mention that matter.

Ouyang Yanqing was also a little embarrassed, then coughed lightly and said, "This time, there will be no more accidents."

How can you make the same mistake a second reason?

At this time, Ouyang Yanqing suddenly thought of something and asked quickly, "By the way, Xiaoxue, have you told your father about what you are going to?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue was stunned, then smiled and said, "I haven't gotten it yet."

Suddenly, the people in Huangcheng quickly retreated.

An Xing was also stunned.

Miss, don't mess with me.

If you took you there, you would definitely be fine, but after you come back, the city lord probably would have to peel him off.

Seeing everyone's attitude, Lu Xue stomped her feet, snorted lightly, and said, "My father will definitely agree."

Sure enough, the next moment, Lu Daosheng's voice sounded from the hall.

"Go ahead, be careful."

Hearing this, Lu Xue's face suddenly turned happy.

"Hehe, thank you dad!"

In a certain space, Lu Daosheng looked at Lu Xue in the hall and shook his head and smiled.

This time I went to the Human Emperor Palace, I had a chance to Lu Xue.

Although his daughter is not short of opportunities, it is still OK to exercise properly.

Besides, this time I stared at it myself, there would never be the accident like the last time.

Inside the main hall.

The city lord had already spoken, and everyone stopped talking.

An Xing also breathed a sigh of relief, and then smiled and said, "Miss, don't worry, I will protect you with my life this time."

"Is that so? Thank you first!"
